body.purpose: Inspect individual vendor receipt events, dates, and delivered quantities.
when_to_use: Inspect individual vendor receipt events, dates, and delivered quantities.
when_not_to_use: Use get_books for distinct catalog rows, get_stock_availability for current remaining units.

rules: Both ISO dates or neither; start included, end excluded.
Distinct known IDs; OR within each list, AND across filters.

preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
